verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Zulip can be self-hosted with the same software as Zulip Cloud, using a documented installer on a server of your choice. Export and import tools let you move between Cloud and your own servers, enterprise features like SAML and LDAP are not paywalled, and community users confirm it is fully FOSS and run their own instances. Hands-on community reports flag real operational friction: a messy install process, limited Linux distribution support, a dedicated server or VM requirement, weak container support, and heavy RAM needs. Missing for 10: smoother packaging or container deployment, broader OS support, and lighter resource requirements.
